beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Compare multiple samples for the same class with page previews, zoom, and available assignment details, then keep the whole file you prefer.
• Open Mix pages when needed to combine, reorder, rotate, or remove pages from different samples.
• Receive PCA, private Google, and RoboSpark work samples through Chrome while preserving assignment details and keeping alternatives available for review.
• Original source revisions are preserved, with storage settings to review older backups.
• Advanced Mode scans readable CPA and Edgenuity samples faster, and debug reports include session, freeze, and background-task details.

Fixes:
• Fixed incoming samples being discarded just because their filenames matched; failed replacements and page combinations preserve the current sample and original files.
• Fixed pressing Enter in the preview page number accidentally accepting the sample.
• Fixed repeated or cancelled course-progress refreshes retaining completed tasks, starting overlapping database work, or showing stale results.
• Fixed background grading remaining busy when a completed worker was cleaned up before its completion was handled.
• Google Drive import and upload now share one sign-in.
• Fixed quiz Attempt Score and decimal Edgenuity grades being missed, and courses outside the current learning period counting toward samples due.
• Courses containing only excused requirements no longer show a Finalize action.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• macOS builds now bundle PyQt6-Qt6 6.11.2, preventing the Qt WaitCursor crash caused by QTBUG-147602.

Fixes:
• Fixed a macOS crash when the app showed the wait cursor.
